text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: The brown water rises across the whole road by 18.4s and the white car sinks until its wheels are covered by 18.8s. Car is small, windows too tiny to show any empty seat. No hazard lights seen yet. Caption unchanged. The empty sidewalk fills the lower third of the frame.
